name: number_partitioning_k4_n16_seed45018__v11_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 16} into 4 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 34. (The total sum is 16*(16+1)/2 = 136, so the target is 136/4 = 34.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 16 integers in {0, ..., 3} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
